A1, B1, C1 = map(int, input().split())

def find_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        t = b
        b = a % b
        a = t
    return a

if B1 <= C1:
    g = find_gcd(A1, B1)
    A1 //= g
    B1 //= g
    print(f"{A1}/{B1}")
elif A1 == B1:
    print("1/1")
else:
    min_diff = 1e18
    ratio_value = A1 / B1
    num_res, den_res = 0, 1
    left_lim, right_lim = 0, B1
    for i in range(1, C1 + 1):
        while i * A1 > right_lim:
            left_lim += B1
            right_lim += B1
        if i * A1 >= left_lim and i * A1 <= right_lim:
            low_b = left_lim // B1
            high_b = right_lim // B1
            low_r = low_b / i
            high_r = high_b / i
            diff_low = abs(ratio_value - low_r)
            diff_high = abs(ratio_value - high_r)
            if diff_high < diff_low:
                if diff_high < min_diff:
                    min_diff = diff_high
                    num_res = high_b
                    den_res = i
            else:
                if diff_low < min_diff:
                    min_diff = diff_low
                    num_res = low_b
                    den_res = i
    g = find_gcd(num_res, den_res)
    num_res //= g
    den_res //= g
    print(f"{num_res}/{den_res}")
